items.markdown:
A **noise maker** can mean either `a festive party toy used to make loud celebratory sounds` or an electronic sound machine that plays soothing background audio to help you sleep.

### Party Noisemakers

- **What they are:** Small handheld toys used to add fun and energy to celebrations like birthdays, graduations, and New Year’s Eve.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14787143799349147160,catalogid:3112504799011195552,gpcid:4850226221191039931,mid:576462833588334754&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7072020176440909003,catalogid:8953323354729355549,gpcid:8709379955837574800,mid:576462716896510467&ibp=oshop)
- **Common types:** Plastic horns, kazoos, whistles, clackers, and groan tubes.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noisemaker)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14787143799349147160,catalogid:3112504799011195552,gpcid:4850226221191039931,mid:576462833588334754&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7072020176440909003,catalogid:8953323354729355549,gpcid:8709379955837574800,mid:576462716896510467&ibp=oshop)
- **Price:** Usually low, ranging from about $3 for a multi-pack of basic favors up to $12 for funny novelty items like a [Novelty Place Groan Tube Go to product viewer dialog for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462833588334754,imageDocid:15134235062340775990,gpcid:4850226221191039931,headlineOfferDocid:5795636246399996345,catalogid:3112504799011195552,productDocid:14787143799349147160,rds:PC_4850226221191039931%7CPROD_PC_4850226221191039931&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjM3K-6gYqXAxXCSPEDHTBGN6AQxa4PegoIAggACAAICxAV).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:7072020176440909003,catalogid:8953323354729355549,gpcid:8709379955837574800,mid:576462716896510467&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:14787143799349147160,catalogid:3112504799011195552,gpcid:4850226221191039931,mid:576462833588334754&ibp=oshop)

### Sleep Sound Machines

- **What they are:** Electronic devices designed to mask disruptive sounds—like barking dogs or traffic—by playing continuous ambient audio.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ck2nN6llWC4&vl=en)[[2]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-white-noise-machine/)
- **Sounds produced:** White, pink, or brown noise, as well as fan hums and nature tracks. You can also test custom sound generators online using platforms like [Noises Online](https://noises.online/).[[1]](https://www.amazon.com/noise-maker/s?k=noise+maker)[[2]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-white-noise-machine/)[[3]](https://www.amazon.com/Dreamegg-White-Noise-Machine-Canceling/dp/B0BBQX7P5J)[[4]](https://noises.online/)
- **Price:** Generally range from $15 for simple portable models up to $100 for advanced units with extra features.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLmB5FvL_LQ&vl=en&t=28)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i2aHLwRHRwI&vl=en&t=17)
